how: Shanghai No.1 Toastmasters Club meets Mondays 7-9 pm near People's Square for public and impromptu speaking practice (not formal competitive debate); guests may visit.
The Shanghai chapter of Ikebana International (founded 2014) runs about nine events a year including demonstrations and exhibitions; regular classes were not confirmed.
DrawingShanghai is an informal open group that sketches and paints around the city on Saturday mornings (described on a 2020 Royal Asiatic Society China event page).
A beginner leather clutch-making workshop was run by Community Center Shanghai at its Pudong Jinqiao centre (one-off event in 2021).
